objects.name: Grocery Shelf
objects.visual_description: A tall, colorful shelf filled with various food items like snacks and canned goods. Provides storage and display for products.

objects.name: Checkout Counter
objects.visual_description: A small, cute checkout counter with a cash register and space for bags. Serves as the payment area.

objects.name: Shopping Cart
objects.visual_description: A small, chibi-style shopping cart with a bright color scheme. Used for carrying groceries around the store.

objects.name: Fruit Stand
objects.visual_description: A colorful display stand filled with various fruits like apples, bananas, and oranges. Adds freshness to the scene.

objects.name: Snack Rack
objects.visual_description: A small rack showcasing a variety of snacks in bright packaging. Attracts customers with its vibrant colors.

objects.name: Fridges full of milk and cheese products
objects.visual_description: A pair of chibi-style fridges with colorful doors, showcasing an assortment of milk bottles and cheese packages. The fridges are cheerful and inviting, enhancing the dairy section of the supermarket.

objects.name: Cute Cat
objects.visual_description: A small, adorable chibi-style cat with big eyes and a playful expression, sitting near the checkout counter. Its fur is a soft pastel color, adding charm to the vibrant supermarket.

objects.name: Chibi Cashier
objects.visual_description: A cute chibi-style cashier with big expressive eyes and a cheerful smile, wearing a colorful uniform. Stands behind the checkout counter, ready to assist customers with their purchases.

objects.name: Entrance Sliding Door
objects.visual_description: A large, chibi-style sliding door with a bright blue frame and transparent glass panels. It opens automatically, welcoming customers into the cheerful supermarket.

objects.name: chibi client 1
objects.visual_description: A small, adorable chibi character with oversized eyes and a cheerful expression, wearing a colorful outfit. They are designed to blend seamlessly into the vibrant atmosphere of the supermarket.

objects.name: Chibi Client 2
objects.visual_description: A cute, chibi-style character with big eyes and a cheerful expression, wearing a colorful outfit. This character is designed to interact with the supermarket environment, adding a playful element to the scene.

objects.name: Chibi Client 3
objects.visual_description: A cute, chibi-style character with oversized eyes and a cheerful expression, dressed in a colorful outfit. They carry a small shopping basket and look excited about shopping.

scene_name: Chibi style, bright colors, simple shapes, playful and happy mood
scene_description: A vibrant and cheerful supermarket designed in a chibi style, featuring colorful shelves stocked with various food items and playful decorations. The atmosphere is lively and inviting, perfect for a mobile app experience.
